title: Uncoordinated Multi-Queue Balance Race
pattern: Acquiring multiple individual queue locks to perform balancing or element transfers without a standardized ordering protocol.
why_bad: It creates a lock-order inversion deadlock when different balancing operations attempt to coordinate overlapping sets of queues concurrently.
detection: CFG demonstrating dynamic acquisition of multiple collection/queue locks within a single function without ordering checks.
counterexample: Ordering locks by memory address (e.g., locking the queue with the lower address first).
